name: bukkit-permissions-yml
description: No permissions plugin: a permissions.yml group node with default true hands everyone the gamemode root and creative, and closes spectator. Skipped on Folia, which does not apply default: true nodes from permissions.yml.

files.permissions.yml:
vpp.test.everyone:
  default: true
  children:
    minecraft.command.gamemode: true
    minecraft.command.gamemode.creative: true
    minecraft.command.gamemode.spectator: false

steps.name: /time set day denied (no node, not op)
